@given(

    new_element=st.integers()
)

    # Property 1: The sum of the list should be equal to Python's built-in sum.
    assert sum_list(input_list) == sum(input_list)

    list_after_add = input_list + [new_element]
    sum_after_add = sum_list(list_after_add)

    assert sum_list(input_list) == sum_list(shuffled_list)
